Currently leading the implementation of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Marketing Automation strategies. I have an IT background and a Master in Digital Marketing from Esic, an extensive knowledge of CRM, SEO, Omni-channel and Social Media.
One of my passions Social Media and where I enjoy the most is doing creative campaigns. With several success stories and Aspid awards that endorse the creativity and impact of the use of Social Media and marketing automation strategies, as well as new ways of interacting with healthcare professionals through services such as the Dermaworld portal in LEO, LEOTV.es and gamifications such as eLEOmental .com.

My other passion, training, where I periodically collaborate and speak on Marketing Automation, Mutichannel and eMail Marketing.

-2019-Marketing Cloud implemented in +15 countries with centralized support and access to Marketing Automation strategy development. Creatives such as the Dermaworld Portal, eLEOmental gamification are implemented at the Region level.

-2014- In just six months LEO Pharma is among the most social laboratories LEO Pharma is currently third in Twitter followers ranking behind Pfizer, Roche. Collaboration in the marketing campaign "Gelvolución", awarded in Best Idea Awards 2014 by Diario Médico.
